scope: Prove the effective GTK2 pixmap-engine rule, its clip region, and the origin of the four registered corner differences

probe.pointer: moved outside the 543x15 bar before capture
probe.effective_layer: A temporary copy of the generated KDE-role palette gtkrc included by the temporary theme; changing only the theme's parent gtkrc did not replace the higher-priority included pixbuf rules.
probe.sentinel: Both effective NORMAL horizontal stepper overlays were temporarily replaced by opaque magenta 15x15 images in the isolated copy only.

clip_measurement.conclusion: All four R344 differences are outside the 15x11 vertical paint clip passed to the stepper overlay. The engine's 15x15 overlay cannot repaint them in the current GTK2 allocation; their pixels remain from surrounding GTK drawing. The normal glyph is not short, and the generated semantic-role image itself matches the VUE cell.

limitations: This establishes the pixbuf overlay clip boundary and the four residual pixels' location outside it; it does not by itself identify which earlier GTK draw operation supplied their underlying colors.
The GtkRange source describes the pixbuf engine's reconstructed stepper dimensions, but no upstream GTK/Motif default is inferred from this host-side test.
The XChat process still predates the GTK2 update and was not restarted; no live XChat rendering or human acceptance is claimed.
next: Continue GTK2/I167. Retain slider-width=11 and trough-border=2 unless a candidate can repaint the full stepper without moving its 15x15 cells or changing the 15px bar/recess. The isolated slider-width=15/trough-border=0 tradeoff is recorded separately in R357 and is not an acceptable fix.
